children.name: Article Lead
children.text: Extend the strict TypeScript dashboard without breaking query, routing, API, cluster, or design contracts.

children.name: Article Callout Text
children.text: Every cache and request that varies by cluster must include or clear cluster scope to prevent cross-cluster stale data.

children.name: Section Body 1
children.text: React and Vite use explicit routing, query caches, reusable components, bundled Monaco, and terminal primitives under a CSP (v0.4.0).

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 0
children.text: Routes live in web/src/routes and the explicit router tree.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 1
children.text: Shared request and domain types live under web/src/types and lib.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 2
children.text: TanStack Query owns server state; Monaco and xterm handle dense tools.

children.name: Section Body 2
children.text: The shared request layer owns credentials, CSRF, errors, cluster selection, and streaming reconnect behavior.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 0
children.text: api<T> injects credentials, CSRF, and localized problem+json errors (v0.4.0).

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 1
children.text: Multipart and raw file requests add csrfHeaders explicitly.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 2
children.text: Sockets bind to cluster and namespace; leaving the server view closes streams (v0.3.0).

children.name: Section Body 3
children.text: Use strict build, lint, Vitest/MSW, and Playwright; wrap UI text with intl and run i18n:extract (v0.4.0).

children.name: Quick Reference Line 1
children.text: 01  cd web && npm ci && npm run dev

children.name: Quick Reference Line 2
children.text: 02  npm test && npm run lint && npm run build

children.name: Quick Reference Line 3
children.text: 03  npm run test:e2e:mock   # live: make test-web-e2e-live
